prompts.anlage: Calm, neutral German voice of a research facility's public address system. Mid register, even pace, precise diction, slightly synthetic like an automated building announcement, no character, no emotion, no accent. Clean studio recording without background noise.
prompts.helmut: A German man in his late fifties, the senior night operator in the control room of a research facility, talking to colleagues over a two-way radio. Deep, resonant voice like a film trailer narrator, slow and steady pace, unhurried authority. Native German, no accent. Clean studio recording without background noise.
prompts.laura: A German woman in her mid-forties, a control room operator on the night shift of a research facility, talking to colleagues over a two-way radio. Calm, smooth and even, low-mid register, short factual sentences with a trace of warmth, never raised. Native German, no accent. Clean studio recording without background noise.
prompts.ben: A German man in his late twenties, the youngest operator in the control room of a research facility on night duty, talking to colleagues over a two-way radio. Clear, relaxed mid register, quick and conversational, effortless and casual yet focused. Native German, no accent. Clean studio recording without background noise.
prompts.mila: A German woman in her early thirties, the night shift supervisor of a research facility, cutting in on the control room's radio when time runs short. Clear, confident and decisive, a voice with opinions, economical with words, never shouting. Native German, no accent. Clean studio recording without background noise.
